difference: Export removes degenerate bevel faces from desks and laptops; source retains editable geometry.

dominant_geometry.details: 113 rolling chairs at 7620 triangles plus 60 sled chairs at 1344 triangles.
21 laptops; 60 tiny beveled keys contribute 6480 of 7468 triangles per laptop.

textures.priority: low: texture reduction would not be the first model-side action

candidates.action: Measure GPU lighting, shadow and Lumen costs before committing model replacement.
candidates.reason: Nanite triangle count alone does not predict final frame time.

candidates.action: Reduce the 1.5 mm laptop key bevels while retaining 3D keys, UVs and positions.
candidates.estimate: 60 keys x (108 - 12) triangles x 21 laptops = 120960 fewer source triangles; 8.4% of stage.
candidates.validation: Needs close-camera before/after comparison; do not simplify laptop screen geometry or move any furniture.

candidates.action: Use lower-detail rolling chair prototypes for closed CAD room, with an optional nearer LOD for the playable room.
candidates.estimate: 72 CAD chairs at tested 1904 triangles instead of 7620 would remove 411552 source triangles (28.6% of stage).
candidates.validation: Test-only decimation was performed on temporary in-memory copies; silhouettes, normals and visual quality have not been approved.

candidates.action: Replace globally baked repeated furniture with shared prototype meshes and ISM/HISM when memory or instance/fallback rendering measurements justify it.
candidates.estimate: Existing Blender mesh-data sharing is lost during export join. Potential asset and fallback/BVH memory reduction is large; no FPS estimate.
candidates.validation: Preserve positions, scales, orientation, materials, and existing collision/line-trace semantics.

candidates.action: Split structural categories by room and contiguous architectural surface if Lumen Surface Cache/Distance Field diagnostics show deficits.
candidates.reason: Current furniture and several architecture groups span the whole floor; separate walls/floors/ceilings are recommended by Epic for Lumen.
candidates.validation: Nanite already culls at cluster granularity, so a large bounding box does not automatically mean every triangle is drawn.

collision_warning: Do not turn the combined furniture groups into one convex/simple collision hull. It could block existing aisles. Preserve current complex shooting traces and validate walking, doorways and stairs after any collider changes.
